design_philosophy: Professional, minimalist, and objective. 95% of the UI is monochrome (Stark White, 10% Grey, Deep Slate). Color is reserved purely for functional guidance and primary actions. The layout uses strict grids and asymmetric weighting for visual interest without sacrificing density.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-slate-900
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-900

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with 'Control Room' dense grids for functional areas.
general_rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
Use strict left-alignment for paragraphs, inputs, and dense content.
Never center-align unless it's a specific empty state or specific hero headline.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-white or bg-slate-50), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO shadow. rounded-lg.
surfaces.cards_hover: Hover state: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border-slate-300 transition-all duration-200
surfaces.header: Solid white background (bg-white), hard bottom border (border-b border-slate-200). NO glassmorphism.

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white rounded-md px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold tracking-wide hover:bg-[#001A7A] transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-slate-600 rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors

inputs_and_forms.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-900 focus:border-[#002FA7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#002FA7] outline-none transition-all

ai_chat.user_message: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4 max-w-[85%] ml-auto shadow-sm
ai_chat.ai_message: bg-slate-50 border border-transparent rounded-lg p-4 max-w-[90%] mr-auto
ai_chat.input_area: border-t border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 sticky bottom-0

animations.list_stagger: Framer motion: initial opacity-0 y-4, animate to opacity-100 y-0, stagger children by 0.05s

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='add-task-button').

logo.usage: Top left of the sidebar/header and on the login screen.

login_background.description: Abstract Swiss brutalist background pattern with grid lines.
login_background.usage: Background for the right/left split pane on the Authentication (Login/Register) screen.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Professional headshot of a smiling man.
user_avatar_placeholder.usage: User profile avatar placeholder in the sidebar and profile settings.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config to use Outfit for 'sans' or 'heading' and Manrope for 'body'.
2. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto.
3. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Tabs, Dialogs) but heavily customize their classes to match the 'surfaces' and 'buttons' rules above.
4. Strip all default rounded-md and shadows from Shadcn cards and replace them with the flat, 1px border style specified in surfaces.
5. For the AI Chat, avoid cartoonish bubbles. Use structured, left/right aligned blocks with clear typography hierarchy.
6. Include data-testid on every clickable element and form input.
7. Implement responsive sidebars (hidden on mobile, hamburger menu).
8. Use the specified media URLs directly. Do not use placehold.it or similar services.
10. Ensure the primary CTA color (#002FA7) is ONLY used for main actions, keeping the rest of the UI monochrome to draw attention effectively.
